knobs.note: Read by bin/deploy-train.sh as ${DEPLOY_CLAIM_STALE_MIN:-30} (BH-1026.1): minutes after which a `claimed` deploy_queue row whose departed_at is still NULL is re-offered to the next departure, so a train that died mid-flight does not strand its batch. 0 = off, a claimed row is never re-offered by age. The default is above one full poll window (40 x 20s ~ 13 min), so a live train is never re-offered from under itself.
